Minesweeper

Clear every safe square. Numbers count the mines touching that square.

010 000
  • Reveal — click / Space. The first click is always safe.
  • Flag — right-click, long-press on touch, or F.
  • Chord — click a number with both buttons (or C / double-click) to open its remaining neighbours once you have flagged enough of them.
  • Move — arrow keys. R starts a new game. Best times are kept in this browser.
